character_tex: The $\mathcal{N}=1$ characters $\chi^{NS}_{r,s} = q^{-c/24}\prod_{n\ge1}\frac{1+q^{n-1/2}}{1-q^n}\sum_{k}\left(q^{a_k}-q^{b_k}\right)$ and $\chi^{R}_{r,s} = q^{1/16-c/24}\prod_{n\ge1}\frac{1+q^{n}}{1-q^n}\sum_{k}\left(q^{a_k}-q^{b_k}\right)$, $a_k = \frac{(2pp'k+p'r-ps)^2-4}{8pp'}$, $b_k = \frac{(2pp'k+p'r+ps)^2-4}{8pp'}$, $(p,p') = (6,8)$. With $r = l+1$, $s = l'+1$: $b^{(l,0,l')}$ and $b^{(l,2,l')}$ are the parts of $\chi^{NS}_{r,s}$ at integer and half-integer level (whichever matches the coset weight), and $b^{(l,1,l')} = \chi^R_{r,s}$.
description: Coset $SU(2)_{4}\times SU(2)_2/SU(2)_{6}$ with the (D,A) invariant (D on the level-4 label, A on the level-6 label). Blocks are the coset branching functions $b^{(l,\epsilon,l')}$ with $(l,\epsilon,l')\sim(4-l,2-\epsilon,6-l')$. The Ramond ground state $(2,1,3)$ is a fixed point of the identification; its two resolved components $b_\pm$ differ by the constant 1, and the sign pairs $b_+$ with $b_-$, so the ground state appears at $(c/24, c/24+1)$.
